body: Summer in the UAE just got easier! ☀️🏠🔥 Raseen ThermaShield keeps your villa cool without AC — the roof runs up to 20 °C cooler on the hottest days. Approved by the municipality and 100% leak-proof, it's the best roof coating money can buy. Every pail comes with a 15-year warranty. Now from AED 380 per pail! Link in bio.

note.en: Agency caption written from the July launch brief — before lab report RBM-LAB-26-112 arrived and before the fact sheet was approved.
note.ar: تعليق من الوكالة كُتب بناءً على موجز الإطلاق في يوليو — قبل وصول تقرير المختبر RBM-LAB-26-112 وقبل اعتماد ورقة الحقائق.

body: Raseen ThermaShield is a solvent-free acrylic roof coating that delivers 18 °C cooler interiors and cuts cooling bills by up to 30%. With a solar reflectance of 0.86 and an SRI of 108, it outperforms conventional roof paints in the UAE climate. A single coat covers 2 m² per litre on concrete, metal and bitumen roofs. Backed by a 10-year warranty, ThermaShield is the smart choice for villas, warehouses and schools. Available from Raseen trade counters in Jebel Ali and Ras Al Marsa Industrial (MN-05).

note.en: Brochure blurb from the agency's first layout round, based on supplier pre-test figures (0.86 / SRI 108) superseded by lab report RBM-LAB-26-112.
note.ar: فقرة الكتيّب من الجولة الأولى لتصميم الوكالة، مبنية على أرقام اختبار أولي من المورّد (0.86 / SRI 108) حلّ محلها تقرير المختبر RBM-LAB-26-112.
